description: A time sequence of sky frames for an animation: the same place, aim, and lens stepped through time. Returns a compact per-frame timeline (instant, twilight, Sun/Moon altitude, Moon phase + bright-limb, whether the Milky Way is in frame) plus the fixed celestial pole and the sky's sidereal rotation per frame. Each frame's full pixel-accurate spec comes from calling sky_view at that instant; this tool plans the timeline. Use for sunset-to-night transitions, star-trail planning, or Moon-phase progressions.

azimuth.description: Center direction: degrees from true north or a compass name like "W"

date.description: First frame, UTC ISO date-time; omit for now

name: sky_view_sequence
